dimensions.assessment: Affects federal land management agencies and local livestock operators grazing cattle on the affected acreage in Tuolumne County, California.
dimensions.evidence: cattle are grazing on the land currently managed by the National Park Service

dimensions.assessment: Administrative transfer of specific land parcels to align agency management authority with existing cattle grazing practices.
dimensions.evidence: allow the land with cattle grazing to be managed by the Forest Service

dimensions.assessment: No significant federal spending or revenue changes are stated or implied.
Applies exclusively to two defined parcels totaling approximately 330 acres in California.
dimensions.evidence: approximately 160 acres of National Forest System land... approximately 170 acres of National Park System land

dimensions.assessment: Permanent transfer of administrative jurisdiction over the specified federal lands.

missing_information: Exact number of grazing permittees affected by the jurisdiction swap
importance_detail.rationale: The bill transfers administrative jurisdiction over two small parcels of federal land (approximately 160 acres and 170 acres) between Yosemite National Park and Stanislaus National Forest in California to align grazing management.
